name: dcg_cool2
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/dcg_cool2; mkdir -p $O
python3 ../map_ground_hq.py coolant_vaults --px 64 --samples 32 --out $O/ground_coolant_vaults.png --watersrc $O/water_src_coolant_vaults.png > $O/ground.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/ground.log; exit 1)
ls -la $O
